title: FloofyCloud
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e93f69a86ef11de25b806747a61b2659fe79ff06_0.webp)

**FloofyCloud** is a Minecraft mod that makes clouds fluffier and overall more visually pleasing. **Without FloofyCloud** ![Without FloofyCloud](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e73fd0a1c01b2f4194b46b11470a65a75640aa5e.png) **With FloofyCloud** ![With Floofy Clouds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6745066736eaf4565d126a0090b5de1d3cc2d01_0.webp) **Important to Know:** - Make sure clouds are set to FANCY for the best experience. - Report **any** issues you find on the GitHub. **Recommended additions:** - [Night Sky Shaders](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/night-sky-shaders) by Delofj - [Skyboxify](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyboxify) by Legacy Visuals Project - [Smooth Skies](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooth-skies) by Microcontrollers FloofyCloud - Floofing up your clouds since 2026™
